name: Valley Bridge
description: An old stone bridge crossing the silver river. Lanterns flicker each evening.

name: Market Square
description: Bustling market with stalls selling spices, trinkets, and rumors.

name: Guild Hall
description: A grand wooden building where merchants and artisans gather. The floorboards creak with secrets.

name: Old Spice Cellar
description: A damp, aromatic cellar beneath the Guild Hall. Crates of rare spices are stacked high, hiding a small meeting table.

name: Forest Trail
description: A narrow, winding path leading into the dense woods. Shadows lengthen here, and the air grows cooler.

name: Forest Clearing
description: A moonlit clearing deep in the woods. Strange stones form a circle in the center.
